title: 釘抜き付きハンマー
description: 施設保守・大工作業台向けの片手ハンマー。木色の曲線柄、鍛造風ヘッド、円形の打撃面、実際に分かれた二股の曲がり爪、柄上端とくさびを造形。机上の平置き姿勢です。釘・材料・打撃や釘抜き動作は含まず、実用品の強度・性能・安全設計は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.180 × 0.053 × 0.333 m、1,840三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A handheld hammer for facility-maintenance and carpentry workbenches, with shaped wood-colored handle, forged-looking head, circular striking face, genuinely split bent claw, handle end and retaining wedge. Presented in a tabletop resting pose. Nails, workpieces, striking and nail-pulling behavior are absent; real strength, performance and safety design are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.180 × 0.053 × 0.333 m; 1,840 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
